platform: Skyward Qmlativ and legacy SMS 2.0; web-based SIS/ERP with cloud hosting and native iOS/Android apps.

distinctive_features.feature: DistrictPulse analytics with dashboards, custom reporting, trend forecasting, and staffing/intervention analysis.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: District leaders can examine trends and inform staffing or intervention decisions using SIS data.

distinctive_features.feature: Configurable MTSS Watchlists and intervention plans.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: District-defined thresholds can surface students needing attention and track intervention progress.

distinctive_features.feature: Ed-Fi API v4, OneRoster 1.1, SIF, and 1EdTech data-privacy certification claims.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Standards-based interoperability can reduce bespoke rostering and data-exchange work.

distinctive_features.feature: Customizable online enrollment forms and workflows.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Districts can adapt registration requirements and review steps to local processes.

distinctive_features.feature: District-wide SIS and finance/HR ERP in a shared data estate.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Student administration and business operations can be managed within one consolidated platform.

distinctive_features.feature: Report Writer with drag-and-drop layouts and access to every field.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: District staff can create tailored reports and control how results are distributed.

weaknesses.issue: Reviews report cluttered legacy screens, difficult navigation, and steep learning curves.
Mobile app reviews cite login failures, freezing, biometric problems, outdated UI, and repeated relogins.
Qmlativ migration may require reports, security, and workflows to be rebuilt or reconfigured.
Reviewers report awkward handling of A/B-day or period-based schedules.
Some reviewers describe reporting as difficult, slow, or expensive.
Official prices and implementation, migration, hosting, and module fees are not publicly itemized.
The reviewed Trust Center did not publish SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification evidence.

ai_features: AI-assisted guidance in the Qmlativ Help Center; no general-purpose workflow copilot is documented.
pricing_model_summary: No public official price sheet; sales quote required. Third-party listings estimate $30,000 annually, with unit and implementation costs unverified.
biggest_strategic_gap: Not a documented full LMS or suite for transport, library, boarding, alumni, or fundraising; mobile ratings are also notably weak.
